sm_a_book_of_names.description: Agata heard things in the cells. The Crusade has an archivist in the Library, a woman they call Archivist Dana Mercer, and she writes everything down: every camp the Crusade has burned, every name, every date. She was a records clerk back home, Agata says, and she's very good at it. There are families from home looking for people who were in those camps, and the Order owes them an answer, even a bad one, so I want her ledger of names. Take the road east into Eastern Tirisfal for the Monastery, and you'll find Mercer in the Closed Stacks, off the long hall in the Library.
sm_a_book_of_names.accept_text: She'll shut your casters down if she can, so bring someone who hits things. The ledger doesn't leave her desk.

sm_a_letter_for_brill.description: I've got a friend in Brill who isn't Forsaken and isn't Horde, and who's never once asked me what I am. His name's Flamewarden Teodor Novak. He watches the Scarlet Monastery for an order called the Pale Flame, and he needs people who can fight. I've written to him about you. I'd like you to carry the letter yourself, so he can see who I mean.
sm_a_letter_for_brill.accept_text: Take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal and walk down into Brill. Novak keeps a room over the inn, and he doesn't bite.

sm_cold_steel.description: The ledger says where the Crusade sends its armour, and it's all made in one place, the forge off the Crusader's Armory in the Monastery. Smithmaster Corra Bellweather works it day and night. I want her tempering notes, because if the Order knows what the Crusade wears, the Order knows where it's thin. The Monastery's east of here, up the road, and the Armory's the middle door under its front. Go through the Training Grounds and the two armouries, and the forge is up the short passage off the Crusader's Armory.
sm_cold_steel.accept_text: She tempers her plate while you hit her, so don't let it pile up.

sm_doans_codex.description: I collect what the living throw away, and Arcanist Doan has something I'd like very much. He's spent years in the Athenaeum at the top of the Monastery's Library, writing a codex of everything he's learned about the dead. It also covers how to end them, which is the part that worries me. I'd like to read it before Doan uses it on anyone else. Bring it to me, and I'll keep it out of the Crusade's hands for good.
sm_doans_codex.accept_text: The Athenaeum's the hall of shelves at the north end of the Library. When Doan's close to dying, he'll try to take the room with him.

sm_drilled_to_die.description: I keep finding Scarlet Soldiers dead in the hills, boys from Southshore who are barely old enough to lift a sword. The Crusade drills them in the Training Grounds of the Monastery's Armory. The man doing the drilling is one of the newcomers, a Sergeant Major Cole Brennan, and he's very good at it. I want Brennan dead and the yard emptied of Scarlet Soldiers. I'd rather fight soldiers than children.
sm_drilled_to_die.accept_text: The Armory's the middle door, and the Training Grounds are the yard inside. Brennan calls recruits in waves, so guard your healer.
sm_drilled_to_die.turn_in_text:
The newcomers brought a lot of things with them. Some of them brought this, apparently.

I'd rather fight soldiers than children, and you've made that likelier.

sm_hearts_of_zeal.description: I want to know what the Crusade puts in its faithful. The Scarlet Torturers and the Scarlet Scryers in the Monastery's Graveyard carry little vials of anointing oil, up in the Monastery north of here, in Eastern Tirisfal. I think there's more in it than oil. Bring me the vials, and I'll find out what makes a man burn his neighbours and sing while he does it. I've seen what they do with it, and I'd like to know how.
sm_hearts_of_zeal.accept_text: The Torturers and the Scryers keep to the halls and the Chamber of Atonement in the Graveyard. Don't drink any of it.

sm_in_the_name_of_the_light.description: The last names on my list are the Crusade's in the Monastery: High Inquisitor Whitemane and Scarlet Commander Mograine, who keep court together in the Cathedral's chancel. I'll tell you plainly that the Dark Lady knows more about the Crusade's newest recruits than the Crusade does, and that she wants the people giving them orders gone. I won't say more than that. Cross the Chapel Gardens, go up the steps, and walk the length of the Crusader's Chapel to the altar. Mograine gets back up once, and Whitemane will try to put you to sleep, so kill them together.
sm_in_the_name_of_the_light.accept_text: Don't stop to admire the chapel. It was built to make you stop.

sm_pages_for_sun_rock.description: I've read Doan's codex through, and one chapter has troubled me. Doan studied the dead that rise far from the Scourge, with no necromancer behind them, and he wrote down how it starts. I've heard the dead are rising like that in Mulgore. I've copied the chapter for Spiritwalker Tohana at Sun Rock Retreat, in Stonetalon, who watches that border. I'd like it carried to him, by someone who won't lose it.
sm_pages_for_sun_rock.accept_text: Take the zeppelin to Orgrimmar and a wind rider to Sun Rock. Tell Tohana the arcanist was wrong about a great deal, but not about this.

sm_the_bloodmages_stone.description: The Monastery's north of here, in Tirisfal. Thalnos holds Honor's Tomb, at the far end of the Graveyard past the open burial ground. His ward drinks spells, so hit him with steel. The stone will be on him. Bring it to me, not to the Master Apothecary, because I want a look at it first.
sm_the_bloodmages_stone.accept_text: Wrap the stone before you put it in your pack. It drinks warmth, and you'll feel it go.

sm_the_captain_of_the_doors.description: I've never told anyone in Brill why the Order left the Crusade, and I'll tell you now. The night Rory Callahan walked out, the Crusade burned a camp of transplants on the Darrowmere road for consorting with the dead. The man who gave the order was Captain Elric Stane, and he captains the Chapel Guard at the Cathedral's doors today. I don't want an apology, I want Stane's signet, so the Flamekeeper knows it's done. The Monastery's east of here, up the road, and the Cathedral's its right-hand door, so cross the Chapel Gardens and go up the steps, and Stane stands at the top.
sm_the_captain_of_the_doors.accept_text: He'll call his centurions to him, so deal with them first or they'll bury you.

sm_the_champion_of_the_hall.description: I keep a list of the Crusade's people who matter, and Herod is near the top of it. He's their champion, and he holds the Hall of Champions at the back of the Armory. Lately he's been sending his trainees down the road to Brill to practise. I want that to stop, and I don't much care how. Put him down, and the road will be quieter for everyone.
sm_the_champion_of_the_hall.accept_text: The Hall of Champions is the last room of the Armory. Herod spins when he's angry, so keep moving, and don't stand in the doorway.

sm_the_flamekeepers_due.description: Teodor's left Stane's signet with me for you, along with a letter. He wants it put into Flamekeeper Rory Callahan's hand at the Bulwark, the Forsaken's wall at the end of Tirisfal's east road, where the Order keeps its quarter. I've kept his room for a long time, and I've never seen him trust anyone with a thing like this. Take the east road out of Tirisfal to the Bulwark, where the Order's banners are on the south side of the street and Rory stands at the keep's door. The road there runs into country that kills people who aren't ready for it, so Teodor says to wait until you are, and then to go.
sm_the_flamekeepers_due.accept_text: He means that about being ready. I'll keep the letter warm until you are.

sm_the_hale_locket.description: I left Stormwind for reasons I don't talk about, and I took the coast road north to Lordaeron before I came south to the Barrens. The Crusade stopped me on that road and took everything I had, including my daughter's locket. I've heard it's in a glass case in the Scarlet Monastery's Gallery of Treasures, which is kept by a Curator Halbrecht. Ride the zeppelin to Tirisfal and take the road east to the Monastery, where the Library's the left-hand door and Halbrecht keeps the Gallery of Treasures past the kennels. I'd like it back.
sm_the_hale_locket.accept_text: He'll call his monks when you start, so kill them before you kill him.

sm_the_hounds_of_the_library.description: I lost two scouts on the Hillsbrad road last month, run down by Scarlet hounds. I tracked the hounds back to the kennels in the Monastery's Library, and to the man who breeds them, Houndmaster Loksey. I want Loksey dead, and his Scarlet Tracking Hounds with him. Their families deserve to hear that the dogs are gone. It's not much, but it's what I can give them.
sm_the_hounds_of_the_library.accept_text: The kennels are in Huntsman's Cloister, at the top of the Library. Kill the hounds first, or they'll lick his wounds closed.

sm_the_master_at_arms.description: I've heard of a man in the Scarlet Monastery's Armory who has never lost a duel. They call him Master-at-Arms Dorran Pike, and they say he parries a blade and sends it back into the one who swung it. I'd like to know if it's true, and the only way to know is to go and find out. Take the zeppelin to Tirisfal and the road east to the Monastery. The Armory's the middle door, and Pike holds the Crusader's Armory.
sm_the_master_at_arms.accept_text: Bring casters, because steel goes back the way it came.

sm_the_monasterys_dead.description: I've buried half of Brill, and some of them twice. The burial ground at the Scarlet Monastery was Lordaeron's before it was the Crusade's, and the people lying in it were somebody's family. They don't rest any more. The Anguished Dead claw their way up out of the graves in the Forlorn Cloister, and the Haunting Phantasms drift among the stones. I want them laid down, gently if you can manage it, and any way you can if you can't.
sm_the_monasterys_dead.accept_text: The Monastery's east of here, up the road. Go into the Graveyard, through the crypt chapel, to the open burial ground with the mausoleum.

sm_the_preacher_in_the_nave.description: I keep the Forsaken chapel in Tarren Mill, and I still pray, which makes me strange even here. I've heard about a preacher in the Scarlet Cathedral, Brother Corwin Ashe, one of the newcomers. He fills the nave every night and sends the faithful out to burn. Faith is the one thing I was allowed to keep, and I don't want to watch it used like that. Stop him, and I'll pray for him afterwards, because somebody should.
sm_the_preacher_in_the_nave.accept_text: The Cathedral's the right-hand door. Go up past the gardens into the Crusader's Chapel. His sermon shields him, so keep at him.

sm_the_scout_in_the_cells.description: I keep a room over the inn in Brill, with a window that looks east toward the Scarlet Monastery, and I've lost a scout. Her name's Agata, and the Crusade took her on the road a week ago. They'll have taken her down into the Graveyard, to the Chamber of Atonement, where Interrogator Maelis does his work. Agata won't have talked, and I want Maelis dead before she has to. The Monastery's at the top of the road east out of Brill, and the Graveyard's down through the crypt chapel on the west side of the close, with Maelis in the torture room at the bottom of the halls.
sm_the_scout_in_the_cells.accept_text: If Agata's alive, tell her Teo sent you. She'll know you're one of ours.
sm_the_scout_in_the_cells.turn_in_text:
She was alive, then, and she's on her way here.

I was a firefighter in Brno before all this. You learn to count who comes out. I'm still counting.

sm_the_sleepless.description: I've looked for Thunder Bluff's dead, and I've found them quiet. A Forsaken traveller who came up the ramp told me about a place where the dead are anything but quiet: the burial ground of the Scarlet Monastery, across the sea in Tirisfal, where a wraith called Azshir the Sleepless feeds on the spirits of the buried. A spirit that's eaten never gets to rest at all, and I'd like Azshir ended, even so far from home. The zeppelins from Orgrimmar go to Tirisfal, and from there it's the road east to the Monastery and down through the crypt chapel into the Graveyard. Azshir walks the burial ground.
sm_the_sleepless.accept_text: Spread out when it wails, and cleanse the curse it lays on you.
sm_the_sleepless.turn_in_text:
I felt something loosen, I think, a long way off.

The dead there aren't ours, but the dead are the dead.
